gen-tourney-gf-nobile: Tourney stretches out wide and bulky, every stroke cut to a single width, like a scoreboard with attitude. Nobile sits beside it as a sans-serif with caps barely taller than its lowercase, which keeps the text quiet.
gen-tourney-gf-nokora: Nokora lays down a dark, steady stripe of lowercase, its s never pinching shut. Tourney is the one for loud, widely tracked letters with diagonals as thick as its uprights, while Nokora handles the quieter reading.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Sporty and bold, Tourney spreads its wide-tracked, single-width strokes across the line, and Noto Kufi Arabic follows with a gentle gap in every c. Shrink the heading and its heft gets lost.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans: Noto Sans fills most of each letter's height with lowercase body and leaves its c wide open. And Tourney, drawn without any thick-to-thin shading, gives it a blunt, chunky partner that makes the plain sans look refined.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart. Tourney does its best work as a heavy, wide-set headline with no swelling in its bowls, while Noto Sans Adlam is built for tall, full lowercase text.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjoined: Tourney's most striking trait is its wide tracking, which stretches every word out across the line. And Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined keeps cases close in height with generous space at the curve ends, so long text goes down smoothly.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-hiero: Chunky, marker-tipped, and built for impact. Tourney does its best work on big, wide-tracked words, while Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs handles text with outward-pointing terminals and an x-height rising close to cap height.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Tourney spreads out its bulky, wide-tracked letters, and its curves never thin at the turns, so every word looks like it was inked with a marker. Enlarge Noto Sans Avestan a touch for comfort.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Professional in tone, Noto Sans Balinese gives every curve its own breathing space and keeps ascenders short. Over a longer passage it reads smoothly, while Tourney's stitched-outline strokes and wide tracking supply the athletic punch.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Wide, wirelike and unmistakably sporty, Tourney keeps every stroke one thickness while Noto Sans Bamum brings big open counters in each small letter. Tourney earns its keep big and short.
